title: observability: token-level tracing + cost/latency breakdowns + alert tuning
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: customers running high-throughput LLM workloads need better per-token visibility into cost and latency, and SRE needs tuned alerts to reduce noisy paging. This PR adds token-level tracing hooks, expands token-level cost/latency metrics, wires them into Grafana dashboards, and applies alert tuning (rate thresholds + cardinality reduction). Changes include: instrumentation in the serving runtime to emit token-level spans and cost attribution tags; a metrics exporter that aggregates token cost and p50/p95/p99 token latency per model/route; Grafana dashboards for cost/latency breakdown by token role and model; updated alert rules to reduce noise and add recovery conditions. Rollout plan: feature flag gated in runtime (OBS_TOKEN_TRACING), gradual enable by customer region via config, dashboard and alert rules deployed to staging for 48h of validation then promoted to prod. Checklist: - [x] Runtime tracing hooks implemented and feature-gated - [x] Metrics exporter implemented and unit-tested - [x] Dashboard panels added and reviewed by observations team - [x] Alert rules tuned and validated in staging - [x] Backwards-compatible: when feature flag off, no change to metrics or traces - [x] Release notes drafted and approved Testing: unit tests for exporter, integration test that verifies traces and metrics appear in local Prometheus/Grafana stack, load test at 2x typical token QPS to ensure exporter scaling. Related: builds on prior token-level observability work (see pr-32567, pr-31856) and addresses SRE-193 noisy alert incident from Oct. Notes: this PR intentionally keeps aggregation at exporter-level instead of runtime to minimize latency impact; we capture per-token span ids and attributes and emit compact aggregated counters. See commits for details.

review_comments: Diego Martinez: Nice work on keeping the runtime path minimal. Two asks: 1) add a histogram bucket justification comment for token sizes; 2) ensure exporter never blocks inference threads. Can you add a non-blocking queue with backpressure metrics?

Aisha Patel: Added non-blocking bounded queue backed by a worker pool in token_exporter.go. Queue metrics exposed as exporter_queue_length and exporter_drops_total. Also added comment about histogram buckets. PTAL.
Marta Kowalski: Alert tuning LGTM. Please add a recovery condition and limit the per-route cardinality to top-10 models by QPS. Also add runbook snippets for on-call.
Aisha Patel: Updated token_latency_rules.yaml to include for: 10m recovery window and topk class_by(model) cardinality reduction. Added runbook section in docs.

Tom Nguyen: Integration test failed initially due to race in tracer initialization under high concurrency. Found and fixed double-init by centralizing tracer registration in runtime/init.go. Re-run tests, all green.
Diego Martinez: Approved after requested changes addressed. CI passed.
merge_commit_message:
observability: token-level tracing + cost/latency dashboards + alert tuning

Adds feature-gated token tracing, exporter aggregation, dashboards, and tuned alert rules. Addresses SRE-193 noisy token-latency alerts.
release_notes: Observability: added token-level tracing and cost/latency dashboards. New alert tuning reduces noisy paging; enable via OBS_TOKEN_TRACING feature flag. No breaking changes when flag is off.
notes: Deployment notes: enable OBS_TOKEN_TRACING=false by default in prod; enable per-region in console with staged rollout. Watch exporter queue metrics and exporter_drops_total on first rollout. If exporter_drops_total > 0, reduce sampling or increase exporter workers.
